scale.provenance: Measured from the ink by row/column profiling, not derived from the room rects below. PRIMARY BEDROOM: at y=250 the flanking walls are x=79-98 and x=585-598, so its interior is 99-584 = 486px against a stated 12'-5" -> 39.14 px/ft; at x=150 the walls are y=101-121 and y=758-771, interior 122-757 = 636px against 16'-4" -> 38.94 px/ft. BEDROOM: at y=250 the walls are x=585-598 and x=1123-1136, interior 599-1122 = 524px against 13'-5" -> 39.06 px/ft. Three independent spans give 38.94-39.14 (+-0.3%); 39.0 is the midpoint. The detector's own pooled estimate over four rooms lands at 38.99 with 0.6% spread, which corroborates but was not used to author this number.

note: A 2036x1440 Matterport export, added because it is the only large crisp vector render in the set and it exercises three things the other fixtures cannot: the 1800-2600px OCR scaling band where ocrScale stays 1, a speculative ROI tail long enough to dominate a scan, and rotated (vertical) dimension labels that the pipeline currently misses entirely.

rooms.note: Interior faces measured directly: left wall 79-98, right wall 585-598 (y=250); top wall 101-121, bottom wall 758-771 (x=150).
